result:
**Decision: CONTINUE.** Round 330 finishes stage c1 of the drag-performance work (PERF-DRAG-PREVIEW). It runs on the same uncommitted tree: HEAD `dae81bf` plus A's 4 changed files from round 329.

**How round 329 ended:** C failed it on a single clause; the Studio itself behaves correctly. Every behaviour and browser check matched HEAD at both viewports. Moving a clip now re-renders about 30 components per move instead of about 107. The one failure: the new project-end readout wasn't memoised, so every transport render (click, zoom, play, range start) re-rendered it as well, one component more than round 328. That's C-R329-01 (Low), and it was my spec error: I wrote "equal to round 328" without running the perf test. The second Low, C-R329-02, is a missing test for the loop part of the overview's length. The gate skipped the round, so nothing was published.

**Round 330 task** (`current-task.md`, decisions D-29z954…D-29z961, backlog v289):
- **Fix for C-R329-01:** the readout gets `memo`, written the way the file already does it (`ArrangementProjectEndTextInner` + `memo`). The shorter inline form is not allowed: when I tried it, the test render counter couldn't see the component at all, so the checks passed without testing anything.
- **New test DP23:** a selection change re-renders the transport but not the readout. It first checks that the readout shows up in the counter at all. Without that check it passed even on round 329's unfixed code.
- **New test DP24 (C-R329-02):** the overview keeps a loop that ends past the moved project end.
- **Doc 232:** its status line no longer claims a C pass that hasn't happened.
- **C's checks:** C repeats every round-329 browser and perf check on the final tree, because 329 and 330 will be published together. The 8 clip-move perf numbers are recorded only, with no "must equal" clause.

**What I measured on my own copy of the fix** (in `b-round-329/`):
- **Perf, production build:** 113 rows equal round 328's, including all range, click, zoom and play rows, and all 36 budgeted rows pass. Only the 8 clip-move rows differ: 30.367 per move, max 108.
- **Browser:** the clip-click render is back to 104 components, the same as HEAD.
- **Tests:** full test suite 3564/3564 and typecheck clean. The 7 deliberately broken versions each made at least one test fail.

**Backlog changes:** nothing is marked done. One reviewer note (no jsdom test for the case where the window, not the project, sets the timeline length) goes to deferred polish; a browser check covers that case. Lesson L58 now says that "equal to an earlier run" is an assertion I must measure before writing it, and that the inline `memo` form is not allowed. `lessons.md` is still 59 lines.

**Next:** round 331 is the REGRESSION round if it's planned on or after 2026-11-05; otherwise it's stage c2. Nothing is ready to commit until C passes round 330.

The advisor was available and I used it twice. Its points changed the plan: fix with `memo` rather than accept the extra render, check that the test counter can see a memoised component, and keep the clip-move perf rows record-only. No project agents were consulted, because this is a one-line fix inside the contract `tech-lead` and `performance-optimizer` already set at round 328. I didn't change anything in `store/`. All my measurements ran on a separate copy at `/home/runner/b329-scratch`.

Files are in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- `current-task.md`
- `tasks/round-329.md`
- `b-round-329.md`
- `b-next.json`
- `backlog.json`
